name: cirqo
description: CIRQO Shopping Connector: the shopper's product search inside their AI assistant. For any shopping question it returns the best-matching products ranked neutrally, from brands that opted in (facts verified by the brand) and brands that did not (labelled not verified). Every fact is checked by plain code before it is returned; no brand can pay for placement. Demo catalog: fictional brands.
funnel: Call search first, from whatever the shopper said. If narrowingHints come back and more than two options remain, ask the shopper one hint question at a time and call search again with the answer added to constraints. When one or two options remain, or no hints come back, call query for the single pick. Never state a fact that is not in the results; tell the shopper which facts are verified by the brand and which are not.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Step 1 of the funnel. Returns up to 5 options ordered by neutral matchScore, each with checked facts and a verified flag, plus up to 3 narrowingHints: the attributes on which the options differ most, each phrased as a question to ask the shopper.

question.description: What the shopper said, however vague, e.g. "I want headphones for the gym".

constraints.description: Optional. Every field is optional. Without them, category and maxPrice are taken from the question. Add one constraint per answered hint.

mustHave.description: Laptops: battery (10h+), light (under 3 lb), screen (15 in+), touch. Any category: a hint's attribute answered yes (e.g. wireless, noiseCancelling) or one of its split keys (e.g. under1oz, over10h).

tools.name: query
tools.description: Step 2 of the funnel: the one pick. Returns one recommended product, alternatives, an answer text built only from verified facts, and the checked claims behind it.

question.description: The shopper's question, e.g. "What is the best laptop under $500 for school?"

constraints.description: Optional. Every field is optional. Without it, maxPrice is taken from a dollar amount in the question.

mustHave.description: battery = 10h+, light = under 3 lb, screen = 15 in+, touch = touchscreen.
